name: How to check your IELTS essay with an AI tutor
description: Get your IELTS writing band score and personalized feedback in 60 seconds using IELTS AI Tutor by IELTSGRADER.

step.name: Paste your essay
step.text: Enter your IELTS question and essay text, or upload a PDF, Word file, or photo of handwritten work.

step.name: Submit for grading
step.text: The AI tutor evaluates Task Response, Coherence, Lexical Resource, and Grammar against official band descriptors.

step.name: Review your report
step.text: Read your band score, fix cards, model answer, and personalized study plan to improve your next essay.
